method: Lines sampled across every scene (first bride-viewing flashback in Amrutha's bedroom and living room with the past groom, the echo montage, present-day bedroom, the new bride-viewing with Gowtham and his father incl. the sweets cover-up, both kitchen flashbacks, Amrutha and Gowtham's private talk, the office with Gowtham's friend, Amrutha telling her friend, the café flashbacks (cooking speech, full-meals speech, gongura/bajji), the night phone call, the wedding farewell and the closing lie speech). Lines are Scribe sentences (two sentences of one speaker merged at 6:32). For each line 4 frames evenly spaced over the line (lines under 1.2 s padded by 0.25 s each side) were extracted into runs/gt/j14Om1SaFYE/frames_spk/line_s<sentence id>.jpg (one 4-frame strip per line; sheet_NN.jpg stack 4 strips) and checked for who is on screen and whose mouth moves, combined with content (names and forms of address such as 'అత్తమ్మ', 'నాన్న', '-రా', '-ే', who answers whom, story logic). Dense frames for ambiguous stretches: dense_175 (prayer), dense_221 (aside), dense_246 (vomit joke), dense_287, dense_309 (sweets cover-up), dense_392 (mother's aside), dense_833 and dense_853 (friend scene), dense_1012 (wedding blessing); face_073 / face_1013 compare the flashback older man with Amrutha's father; crop_1014 + a median-F0 pitch check on the audio for the wedding blessing. 220 lines were labelled in all; 128 kept for the key (every low-confidence, off-screen and minor-character line, plus a thinned sample of the clear lead lines). Speaker decided from frames and content before looking at Scribe labels; Scribe label (majority word speaker, ties by overlap seconds, as eval.speakers.line_label) and its time share added afterwards. Pipeline outputs (runs/selection_v2, runs/speaker_fix, runs/name_test, data/series_cast) were not opened.

label_conventions.speaker: character name from the list; 'OFFSCREEN:<name>' = the speaker is not visible during the line (reaction shot held on a listener, insert shot, memory/echo voice-over) but is identified from content/voice context; 'UNKNOWN' = cannot tell. For diarization scoring, strip the OFFSCREEN: prefix.
label_conventions.confidence: 3 = seen speaking and/or unambiguous from content; 2 = likely (wide shot, back to camera or cut mid-line, content supports); 1 = guess
label_conventions.times: seconds in the episode audio; keyed by time, not by Scribe line id
label_conventions.on_screen: everyone visible at any moment during the line (union over the line's frames); [] = nobody (an insert shot such as a pan on the stove); on_screen_partly = only a back / shoulder / chest is visible. Independent of speaker: the speaker may be off screen while others are shown. Lines without on_screen are not scored for it.
label_conventions.voices: only on lines with more than one voice: a list in time order of {from_text: the first word of that voice's part, copied from the line's text, speakers: [names]}; two people one after another = two entries; several people saying it together (group line, everyone laughing a word) = one entry with several names. Lines without voices were checked and have a single voice (clip-gt-editor 2026-11-02: Scribe word speakers inside the line, content, frames; no line in this key needed it).

hard_cases: 4:06-4:11 'ఆ వంకలు కాదు. అంటే వంటలు తిని తిని వాంతులు వరదలా వచ్చేవన్నమాట' is a wide two-shot; frames at 3 fps (dense_246.jpg) show Gowtham turned to his father talking and gesturing while the father's mouth stays closed, and the next lines ('మా వోడి అభిమానం' father, 'అది అభిమానం కాదు నాన్న' Gowtham) fit the son making the joke. Assigned to Gowtham at confidence 2; the father self-correcting is the alternative reading.

5:09-5:13 'super అత్తమ్మ' / 'ఏం acting చేస్తున్నావే' (dense_309.jpg): the camera holds on the beaming mother and Amrutha; the praise is off-screen from the guests' side and 'అత్తమ్మ' is how Gowtham addresses her elsewhere (OFFSCREEN:Gowtham, 2); the jab is Amrutha turning to her mother. 'ఓహో!' before it (5:09) is left out: Gowtham or his father, cannot tell.
11:28-16:20 is Amrutha with her FRIEND (maroon top), not her mother ('ఓసేయ్! నీకేమన్నా పిచ్చా?' is the friend's line). An earlier GT map (runs/gt/j14Om1SaFYE/map.md, scene 9) had this as the mother.

14:15 'ఇంక నా వల్ల కాదే' (dense_853.jpg): the friend holds her forehead in despair by the fridge while Amrutha, back to camera, opens it. It could be the friend giving up teaching or Amrutha giving up cooking; labelled the friend at confidence 1. The line after it ('కానీ నేనైతే ఒకటి చెప్తానే') is the friend (Amrutha is drinking from a bottle).

13:50-13:56 'అలా చెప్తే ఎవరూ No చెప్పగలరే?' and 'అయితే yes ఏ చెప్పే' (dense_833.jpg): Amrutha's face is half hidden by her knees; only the friend's lips move. 'కదా!' between them is left out because I could not see who said it.

Wedding farewell 16:54-16:58 'దీర్ఘాయుష్మాన్ భవ! పిల్ల పాపాలతో చల్లగా ఉండండి' is a wide shot where both of Amrutha's parents raise a hand over the couple (crop_1014.jpg). I first gave it to Amrutha's father (glasses, blue check shirt; he raises his hand first). After adding Scribe labels, Scribe's cluster for it was the one it uses for the friend (a female voice), so I re-checked with evidence independent of Scribe: median pitch of the two lines is ~174/186 Hz, matching the mother's wedding lines (178-222 Hz) and above every male line in the episode (102-157 Hz), and in a face crop the father's mouth does not clearly move while the mother smiles with her mouth open and raises her hand on the second line. Relabelled Amrutha's mother (confidence 1 and 2). Amrutha's father therefore has no line in the key and is not listed. 17:02 'నా కాలం మీద పడలేదు. ఏంది ఇది.' is Gowtham's father complaining he was skipped.

1:12 'అమ్మాయిని ఏమన్నా అడగాలంటే అడుగు బాబు' is said by the older man in a white-grey check shirt with a moustache, who is not Amrutha's father seen at the wedding (glasses, blue check shirt, face_1013.jpg), so he is the past groom's father (confidence 2).

Echo and memory voices are labelled OFFSCREEN: the past groom's 'మీరు కొంచెం పొట్టిగా ఉన్నారు' echo over the montage at 1:55 and over Amrutha's face at 7:44 (confidence 2; the voice is post-produced and could be a composite of different grooms), and Gowtham's café lines replayed at 16:25-16:38 while Amrutha stands alone at night (confidence 3).

Under-the-breath asides on the viewing day ('చచ్చింది గొర్ర' 3:41, 'దేవుడా... set అయ్యేట్టు చూడు తండ్రి' 2:57, 'ఏం అడుగుతాడో ఏమో? ఈ తింగరి దెయ్యం చెప్పుద్దు' 6:32) are the mother by content; her lips barely move or the shot is wide, so confidence 2.

Left out as unreadable: 5:17 'సూర్య మామది ప్రకృతి జాతి' (garbled, over music), 17:44 'మొత్తం నా car delivery చేస్తూ తిట్టేదినే విడిచావు' (garbled; Gowtham's phone rings while his father laughs) and 17:48 'Bye మామ' (Amrutha's father is hugging her; speaker not visible).
